INTRO.title: Acoustic panels for interior designers and architects
INTRO.lede: Just Acoustics designs, supplies and installs fabric wrapped acoustic panels across Singapore. Send us a plan and we send back a spec sheet, a render and a trade quote, usually within the hour.
who: We are a Singapore acoustic treatment company. We plan the layout, supply the panels and install them with our own team, so you deal with one party from drawing to handover.

Our work covers offices, restaurants and cafés, studios, schools, churches, clinics and homes. Most rooms are installed in a few hours to two days, and we can work after hours or on weekends around your site programme.

We do acoustic treatment: making a room sound clearer and calmer by controlling echo. We are not a soundproofing contractor, and we will tell you early if a brief really needs sound isolation instead.
for_designers: A plan in, a spec out
Send a floor plan, elevation or a few photos. We return a panel layout, a render in your colours, a spec sheet and a trade quote.
Proposals can carry your logo, with our name kept small, so you present one scheme to your client.
Every proposal states the room's estimated RT60 before and after treatment, so you can show the client what changes.
Our crew installs and cleans up. You get one point of contact and photos at handover.

CERTS: SGS report XMIN180901795CCM (test by Tsinghua University building environment lab)
Fabric: UK Furniture and Furnishings (Fire) (Safety) Regulations 1988, Sch. 4 Part I and Sch. 5 Part I
BS 476 Part 4 and ASTM E136 non-combustibility
Singapore Green Label or SGBC certification
CERT_NOTE: Reports cover the Flexi™ core and fabric and are available on request. Fire-safety acceptance of an installation rests with the project's QP and the relevant authority.

COLOURS.note: Colours are dyed fabric, so screens and print will differ. Ask for the physical swatch card before you specify. A paintable white face is available when you need an exact paint match.

EDGES: The standard Flexi™ edge. A small chamfer softens the panel outline and reads well in grids with even reveals.
A square, crisp edge for tight-butted runs and full-wall layouts.
FIXING: Impaling clips and adhesive. Clean and quick on painted plaster and board.
Clips screwed to board or masonry where adhesive is not suitable.
Fixed tight to the soffit with helical anchors, four per panel.
Hung about 100 mm below the soffit on four spring and wire sets, one per corner.
Perimeter track on the wall or ceiling, fabric stretched over the infill.
FIXING_NOTES: Panels go on solid walls and ceilings only. We do not fix to glass, windows or demountable partitions.
Ceilings above 3 m need mobile scaffolding. We plan this in the quote.
We keep clear of sprinklers, detectors, diffusers and lights, and model every fixture in the 3D layout first.
LEAD_TIMES: Spec sheet, render and trade quote within an hour of a usable plan in working hours.
About 15 working days after the deposit. Nothing is cut before the deposit is received.
Sea freight 14 to 18 days, or express air freight in a few days at extra cost.
A few hours to two days on site, after hours or weekends if needed.
About 4 to 6 weeks from deposit to installed. We confirm a date when you order.
SPACE_TIPS: Treat the two long walls at seated head height, staggered so panels do not face each other. Add a ceiling cloud over the table in rooms over 3 m high.
Most of the noise comes off hard ceilings. Suspended clouds over the dining area do the heavy lifting; wall panels above banquettes add warmth.
Ceiling clouds over desks first, then wall panels behind call areas and on glass-facing walls opposite.
Keep it calm: tall panels in a soft colour on one or two walls, and flush white ceiling panels where the ceiling is bare.
Treat first reflection points, the wall behind the listener and the corners. Use 100 mm panels for bass.
RT60_EXAMPLES: Clinic consult rooms, about 12 m³ each

CASES.title: Restaurant dining room
CASES.brief: A busy Italian dining room with a hard ceiling and long banquette walls. Conversations were getting lost by mid-service.
CASES.work: 9 fabric wrapped panels, bevel edged, 50 mm, made to fit above the banquettes: custom widths from 1,204 to 1,748 mm at 510 mm high. A top-up to an earlier ceiling treatment.

CASES.title: Corporate meeting rooms
CASES.brief: Video-call rooms with glass, hard walls and a lot of speech. Calls sounded hollow at both ends.
CASES.work: 30 m² of the Flexi™ fabric wall system, 25 mm, on a perimeter track, in fabric colour Champagne, wall to wall behind the screens.

CASES.title: New office, two rooms
CASES.brief: A fresh fit-out with bare white walls and a glass front. The meeting rooms rang.
CASES.work: 14 Flexi™ fabric wrapped panels, bevel edged, 1200 × 600 × 50 mm, in grey, mounted vertically on the solid walls.

CASES.title: Reformer pilates studio
CASES.brief: A high, hard ceiling over a full reformer floor. Instructors had to shout over the music.
CASES.work: 22 Flexi™ ceiling panels, 1200 × 600 × 50 mm, in a colour chosen by the client, set in a grid with the lighting, above 3 m.

CASES.title: Grand piano living room
CASES.brief: A grand piano in an open living and dining room. Notes rang on and the room felt harsh.
CASES.work: 6 white ceiling panels fixed flush (2 at 1000 × 1000, 4 at 1200 × 1000 × 50 mm) and 4 wall panels in Beige 01 (1 at 1600 × 1000, 3 at 1000 × 700 × 50 mm).

TRADE_STEPS: Upload a floor plan, RCP or elevation (PDF, DWG or a photo), with ceiling height, finishes and the client's brief. Photos of the site help.
We send back a panel layout, a render in your chosen colours, a one-page spec sheet and a trade quote with the RT60 before and after.
Choose our branding or yours. White-label proposals carry your logo, with Just Acoustics kept small.
On your go-ahead and the deposit we order, confirm the install date and install. You get photos at handover.
